run_mmdet_model_evaluation: run an MMDetection model test and evaluation on a dataset using a config file and checkpoint
run_single_gpu_test: run a single GPU test on an MMDetection model with visualization options and score threshold
run_multi_gpu_test: run a multi-GPU distributed test on an MMDetection model across multiple workers
format_test_results: format MMDetection test output results for submission to a test server without evaluation
fuse_conv_bn_for_inference: fuse convolution and batch normalization layers in an MMDetection model to increase inference speed
